verdict.rationale: Browserbase claims it can 'spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions' and offers a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. Programmatic session control comes through the SDK, and webhooks remove the need to poll for status changes, so the parts for asynchronous large-scale scraping exist. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated batch or bulk scrape endpoint or job queue, so the data engineer must orchestrate fan-out across URLs themselves. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk URL scraping API or job queue, rate-limit and retry handling for large batches, independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at thousands of URLs.
